svg.desc: CRITIQUE demolition plates: fifteen torn-gouge tablet marks, two relief bands, four end-seals. Book II, Critique of the Highest Values Hitherto.

symbol.title: Sealed tablet with a single crack
Tablet split open with light in the crack
Self split: shadow half and lit half
Altar wrenched into standing and falling slabs
The holy word eroded; the compass snapped
Specimen slab under the calipers
Herd band with one upright exception
Snapped causa chain over receding fragments
Stage flat: the mask half-lifted from the face
Aspiration loom slashed; the heart caught in the weave
Seal devouring itself: the ouroboros ring
Seven wedges hurled at philosophy
Stele: Sophists run, priests stand, the crack between
Limit-arc overgrown by the living vine
Remains below, the lamp above
Relief: the altar fracture runs the width
Relief: the warp severed at the turn
Seal: the keys, cancelled
Seal: bridle against cage
Seal: the devoured ring at rest
Colophon: the hermit's lamp
